title: DeepSE: Detecting super-enhancers among typical enhancers using only sequence feature embeddings.
authors: Ji, Qiao-Ying; Gong, Xiu-Jun; Li, Hao-Min; Du, Pu-Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度卷积网络和dna2vec序列嵌入区分超级增强子与典型增强子，虽涉及DNA序列和调控元件，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Super-enhancer (SE) is a cluster of active typical enhancers (TE) with high levels of the Mediator complex, master transcriptional factors, and chromatin regulators. SEs play a key role in the control of cell identity and disease. Traditionally, scientists used a variety of high-throughput data of different transcriptional factors or chromatin marks to distinguish SEs from TEs. This kind of experimental methods are usually costly and time-consuming. In this paper, we proposed a model DeepSE, which is based on a deep convolutional neural network model, to distinguish the SEs from TEs. DeepSE represent the DNA sequences using the dna2vec feature embeddings. With only the DNA sequence information, DeepSE outperformed all state-of-the-art methods. In addition, DeepSE can be generalized well across different cell lines, which implied that cell-type specific SEs may share hidden sequence patterns across different cell lines. The source code and data are stored in GitHub (https://github.com/QiaoyingJi/DeepSE).
abstract_zh: 超级增强子（SE）是含有高水平中介体复合物、主转录因子及染色质调节因子的活性典型增强子（TE）簇。SE在控制细胞身份和疾病中发挥关键作用。传统上，科学家利用多种不同转录因子或染色质标记的高通量数据来区分SE与TE。这类实验方法通常成本高昂且耗时。本文中，我们提出了一种基于深度卷积神经网络模型的DeepSE模型，用于区分SE与TE。DeepSE使用dna2vec特征嵌入表示DNA序列。仅凭DNA序列信息，DeepSE即超越了所有现有最先进方法。此外，DeepSE在不同细胞系间具有良好的泛化能力，这表明细胞类型特异性SE可能在不同细胞系间共享隐藏的序列模式。源代码和数据存储于GitHub（https://github.com/QiaoyingJi/DeepSE）。
